subject: Request: latest Red Team assessment for Hosted API + secure transfer options
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Can you share your latest red-team report for Hosted API?

Hi Marissa,

We are updating our control environment for an upcoming SOC 2 re-audit and SIG review. Could you provide the most recent red-team / offensive security assessment that covers Redwood's hosted API surface? Specifically we need:
- A redacted copy of the full report (sensitive customer data redacted)
- A short remediation status summary (open / in progress / closed) tied to findings
- Confirmation of the scope (hosted API endpoints / management console) and test dates

Our InfoSec team prefers a secure delivery method (one-time download token or ephemeral portal). Can you advise what options you support and how long any presigned links remain valid? Also let me know what legal / NDA steps are required on our side.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Head of Security Operations
Acme Health

---
Attachment: none
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Can you share your latest red-team report for Hosted API?

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely share the red-team assessment that covers the Hosted API surface (no dedicated/private tenant data included). A few quick clarifications so we prepare the correct artifacts:

- Scope: confirm you only need Hosted API + Console. If you need Dedicated or Private, call that out (those are separate assessments).
- Redaction: we will redact customer-specific identifiers and any PII. The redacted summary is what we normally provide to customers during audits.
- Delivery options (pick one):
  1) Ephemeral review portal (secure.redwood.ai) — timeboxed browser review with download disabled; preferred for the full report.
  2) One-time presigned S3 URL (24-48h expiry) — downloadable PDF.
  3) Password-encrypted PDF/ZIP delivered via presigned link; password sent by voice to a designated contact.

What we typically include in the package: redteam-summary-2026-06-redacted.pdf (executive + findings), full report available under controlled review, and remediation-log-2026-09.csv (current status per finding).

If you’re OK with option 2 or 3, we can issue a presigned link valid for 48 hours by default. If you prefer the ephemeral portal, I’ll coordinate with Rishi (cc) to set up an access window and any required reviewer registration.

NDA/legal: we don’t require a separate NDA for the redacted summary, but full report access via the portal requires a standard non-disclosure that your legal team can sign electronically. If needed, I can send the DocuSign link.

Next step: reply with preferred delivery option and the contact name/phone for password exchange (if option 3). I’ll loop engineering/security once you confirm.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0142
